service: 1 tonne CO2 physically retained in geological storage after conditioning and transport losses
comparison: CCS minus BAU for the same associated clinker output; avoided emissions are not atmospheric removal
method: Linear unit conversion of reviewed results. Static factors use each matching foreground; temporal and FaIR factors use equal-output mean storage over 2035–2064, matching the released per-tonne-clinker cohort normalization. Not a new LCA or FaIR run.
scope: Derived normalization factors only; no private engineering inventory, provider copies or source cells exported. Requested by the presenter on 29 October 2026.
current_capture_heat: Gas boiler with explicit boiler-carbon recapture
future_capture_heat: Heat pumps; no capture-boiler combustion stream
